tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mdos kyi gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// sgyu ma'i 'jig rten mthun zhugs pa'i// sgyu ma chen po'i dkyil 'khor la// sgyu ma'i mchod pa sbyar mkhas pa'i// sgyu ma mkhan rnams phyag bya'i 'os// 'di la mdos kyi rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ lag len gyi bcas gnyis/ dang po la/ ngo bo/ nges tshigadabye ba/ byin gyis brlab cing bsngo ba bzhi/ dang po/ sna tshogs su snang ba thabs kyi ye shes de dag cir yang ma grub pa ni stong pa nyid de/ de gnyis gnyis su mi phyed pa'o// gnyis pa ni// de nyid glud rdzas chen por byas pa la mdos te yas btags/ yang*/ zan la gzugs sna tshogs su bkod pa yas dang*/ snal ma sbran pa la thags su byas pas yas thags/ yang slob dpon chen pos/ mdos pa sel ba la yang gsungs te/ de'i tshe rnal 'byor pa la mdos pa nyams chag sbyin bdag la mdos pa chags che nyams nga*/ dgra bo la mdos pa byad ma mkhan gyis byad du bcug pa/ de cho ga mkhan pos thabs kyis sel bas na mdos so// gsum pa ni// pho mdos/ mo mdos/ re re la'ang spyi mdos dang sgos mdos gnyis/ sgos mdos la sum brgya drug cu/ spyi mdos la mahā shān+tiṃ dang*/ sarba rū pa gnyis/ dang po la/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ phyi ma la phyi nang gnyis rnams las/ 'dir srid pa pho mdos/ de'i nang nas dpal ye shes mgon po chen po'i mdos te/ dngos grub 'byung ba las/ ri rab kyi gzugs la sna tshogs pa'i gzugs brnyan bkod de 'phrin las sems pa dang bcas pa'i phyag rgyas btab na g.yul chen po de las rnam par rgyal bar byed do// zhes pas g.yul bzlog sogs dang*/ yang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa'i tshul du byas la/ a shwa ka'am bi dra ka'i shing la brten nas thabs dang ldan pas ni yul phyogs de yongs su rgyas pa'i gnas thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas rten mdos sogs bshad do// de yang spyir sgrub mdos dang rten mdos dang*/ mchod mdos dang bskang mdos dang*/

srid pa g.yul bzlog dang byol bzlog dang*/ rāk+ṣa dgra mdos la sogs ba du mar byed pa dang*/ mdos kyi bcas gcig la kun tshang bar byed pa'o// bzhi pa la/ byin gyis brlab pa dang bsngo ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mdos rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rgyan glud thams cad dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du bsams byin gyis brlabs la/ snyan gsan phab/ spyan drangs/ bzhugs su gsol/ gnyis med du bstim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod bya ba ni/ mdos dkyil 'khor du shes pa zhes bya sgrub mdos sam rten mdos kyi skabs/ mdos gzhi gnam 'khor lo rtsibs stong mu khyud kyis mdzes pa 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam pa la yas thags kyis nam mkha'i rgyan skar ma'i tshogs ltar bkram pa/ sa gzhi'i rgyan rtsi shing nags tshal ltar spungs 'thug pa/ bar snang gi rgyan sprin dang 'ja' tshon bzhin byin chags la bkra ba/ re re 'ang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i byin gyis brlab pa mdos mchod rdzas su shes pa zhes bya/ des dregs pa rnams ma sring lta bur lta bar byed pas gar spyi phud kyi mdos zhes kyang bya'o// yang*/ bdag dam tshig g.yel bas dregs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las nogs pa na rgyal glud sku'i/ mda' 'phang gsung*/ nam mkha' thugs/ dar dang rgyal mtshan yon tan/ spyan gzigs rngon cha 'phrin las kyi bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul bas nyams pa bskang bas bskang mdos zhes bya'o// lan chags kyi mgron dmigs te/ mdos yas thags ri rab gling bcu gnyis 'dod pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa'i gter du byin gyis brlabs nas bdag la gzhan gyi drin lan chags pa 'khor ba'i phyir btang na lan chags gtong 'phrin gyi mdos zhes bya/ mdos yas sbyin bdag dang lha 'dre'i gzugs 'dra bar dmigs nas bdag gzhan gyi glud bu btang na tshe zla rgyas kyi mdos zhes bya/

yas thags kyi rdzas thams cad snang srid lha 'dre'i dmag dang dpung du byin gyis brlabs nas bdag gzhan la gnod pa bzlog par btang ba ni nag po phyogs bzlog gi mdos sam mgon po g.yul bzlog gi mdos zhes bya/ yang srid pa lugs bzhin du bshams nas mo brgyud du byin gyis brlabs nas pho brgyud la btang ba na srid pa pho'i byol bzlog pho brgyud du byin gyis brlabs nas mo brgyud la rdzongs su bstabs pa srid pa ma mo'i byol bzlog lhag par rbad 'dre thu ba dmigs kyis bsal na spyi bzhin bcas/ de kho na la btang na spyi mdos sgos su btang ba/ yang dmigs kyi ma bsal na sgos mdos bcas pa spyi la btang na sgos mdos spyi la'o// yang mdos kyi bcas la pho gtso bor bkod na pho mdos/ mo gtso bor bkod na mo mdos/ 'di ltar snang ba drag po'i 'phang rdzas su byed pa la zor zhes btags te/ yang drag por 'phen pa la yang zor ces pa bzhin no// gzhi drag po'i 'brub khung*/ rdzas zor nad dang dug dang mtshon cha/ dregs pa rnams thun gyi lhar shes pa las dgra bo'i lus sems 'bral bar byed par byin gyis brlabs te/ thebs bzlog brtsis nas btang na rāk+ṣa dgra mdos so// rnal 'byor pa dngos grub sgrub pa byed na brten pa'i mdos bya/ dam tshig nyams pa gso na bskang ba dang*/ tshogs rdzogs par 'dod na mchod mdos/ yul du nang 'khrug gzhan gyi dmag lhags pa sogs pha rol gyi bsam ngan bzlog na g.yul bzlog ma mo 'khrugs pa'i dal yams dang rbad 'dre/ lha 'dre mi bsrun pa'i sdang zur zug pa la byol bzlog gnyis/ dgra bo sgrol ba la zor mdos thun mdos sam/ khrag mdos sam dgra mdos/ nor god bzlog pa la lan chags stong 'phrin/ 'chi ltas byung na blu ba la tshe rgyas kyi mdos bya'o// g.yul bzlog byol bzlog dgra mdos la/ nyin dang po mchod rdzas bskang rdzas su phul/ phyi de nyin nas bskyed chog bya bas sgrub mdos dang phyis 'phang mdos su shes par bya/

mdos de dag dgra bo'i sha khrag rus par dmigs nas phul na mdos drag po'i gtor mar gtong ba/ yul la sogs par ltas ngan pa byung na/ de bris nas byol bzlog bzhin du bya ba ltas ngan bzlog pa'i mdos zhes bya ba de lta bu'i mdos kyi 'phrul mig chen por shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bsngo ba la/ dang por mdos kyi sgo dbye ba/ mdos la rdzongs bstab pa/ mdos gzhug zor gyis bcad pa gsum mo// dang po la/ rnal 'byor pa'i sgo dbye/ dregs pa'i sgo dbye/ mdos kyi sgo dbye/ dang po sngags pa thod kha g.yas su gser/ g.yon du g.yu/ las kyi skabs shes pa'i chas su zhugs te lus yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan pa lus kyi sgo dbye/ mdos bdag pho mo'i srog snying mtshang tshig shes pa ngag gi gnyis su med par rtogs pa yid kyi sgo dbye shes dgos so// de med na rim pa bzhin/ dregs pa dbang du mi 'du ba dang*/ bsngos pa gnas su mi phyin pa dang*/ thams cad 'khor ba'i g.yas sbyor du 'gro/ gnyis pa mdos bdag gi sgo dbye ba la/ spyan drangs/ mtshang 'dru/ thun rdzas byin gyis brlab pa gsum shes dgos/ de ma shes na rim pa bzhin/ spyan ma drangs na mi 'byon/ mtshang ma drus na yas mi len/ dgos don ma tshang na mi rdzongs pa'i skyon gsum 'byung*/ gsum pa mdos kyi sgo dbye ba la/ dang por brkos btab pa/ mdos sna glud kyis drangs te bsngo ba/ yas chad smeng gis 'thud pa gsum shes dgos/ de ma shes na rim pa bzhin/ lha 'dre 'khrug pa/ yon bdag gi tshe srog nyams pa tshur mi khugs pa/ phan las gnod che ste lag na ci yang med pa la khyod kyi 'di gyis zer ba dang 'dra bas so// gnyis pa mdos kyi rdzongs bstab pa la/ rab lta bas thag bcad de rdzongs bstab/ 'bring spyod pa la dor te rdzongs bstab pa/ mtha' ma ting nge 'dzin dbang bsgyur te rdzongs bstab pa gsum/ dang po/ mdos chos nyid du shes pa ste chos sku/

byang chub kyi sems skye ba med pa'i ngang las/ rig pa 'gag pa med pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rtsal/ mdos bdag yon bdag rnal 'byor pa cir yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa yin pas/ snang ba cir snang yang ngo bo la brtags na gang du'ang ma grub pas/ de ka thig le chen po/ gdal ba chen po tshul 'dis yang dag mtha' grol gyi klong du thams cad gcig par shes pa ni thig le'i klong mdos sam/ sku gsum gdal ba'i klong du mdos pas ye shes chen po'i mdos zhes kyang bya'o// gnyis pa spyod pa tshad med bzhi dang ldan pas snang srid thams cad mdos la rdzongs 'debs pa ste/ de med na dregs pa pho mo'i thugs dam mi bskongs so// gsum pa mdos dregs pa la rdzongs su bstab pa ste/ de med na phan gnod kyi las mi 'grub pa'o// gsum pa mdos gzhug la mdos kyi lam bstan pa phan mdos la/ chu gnas thams cad rgya mtshor/ nam mkhar gnas pa thams cad dgu tshigs/ sa gzhi la gnas pa thams cad phyogs bcur lam bstan no// de ma bstan na yul du nad yams dang yon bdag la phye bkren ldang*/ mdos bdag gi lam bstan pa ni/ thams cad rang gnas su gshegs su gsol dgos/ de ma shes na/ sngags pa'i shul mi la gnod do// mdos bskyal sa yang*/ rang gi khams dang bstun pa'i phyogs kyi dregs pa gnas pa'am/ dpyid ri rtse/ dbyar chu gzhung*/ ston dur khrod/ dgun lam rgya gram du skyel bar bshad do// zor du 'phang ba ni/ dgra bo'i phyogs la lam ston/ de la thebs bzlog brtsi dgos te/ thebs ni pho mdos zla ba yar ngo dang snga dro/ mo mdos mar ngo dgong dang srod/ dgra mdos nam gung nyin gung nyi nub/ bzlog pa ni/ pho byol nyi ma gung dang nam gung la btang na log mo byol tho rangs nyin gung la log gnyis ka la rdzas ma tshogs na yon bdag la mdos/ ma blangs na lha 'dre la mdos/ ting nge 'dzin ma gsal na sngags pa la mdos/

log gnon/ spyi mdos log na mnan pa bya/ sgrub mdos log na sbyin sreg bya/ yang na lan mang du bskyar/ gnod mdos log na thun du sgrub/ zor du 'phang*/ mnan pa bya'o// sgos mdos log na gtor ma rgya chen po btang ngo*// mdos sreg pa dang mnan pa ni 'phang ba'i rjes las te gtor chen bzhin no// phan yon ni/ gnas skabs kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pas mthar thug sangs rgyas 'grub pa'o// gnyis pa lag len gyi bcas la/ rdzas dang bca' tshul gnyis/ rdzas la/ rgyan glud/ dkor cha/ spyan gzigs/ dang po rgyan glud la nam mkha'/ rgyang bu/ shing gri/ mda' bkra/ 'phang bkra/ pho gdong mo gdong*/ rgyal mtshan/ ru dar la sogs pa'o// dang po ni/ smyug ma mda' gang gshags pa la lus dang sbyar ba'i rtags lag pa gnyis tshon skud sna lnga'i thags khong stong nang sngo ba nas rim pas mtha' ma 'ja' ris su bskor ba/ rtse la bya'i rigs su gtogs pa mdzes pa'i spu dang bal tshon sna lnga'am/ lag pa gnyis la dar bal shog bu'i dpyangs/ yungs kar gyi sgang bu mtshe'i mgal ba de la mthun pa rdzas kyi nam mkha' zer/ de'i dkyil stong pa'am sbugs yod pa ni/ dbyings mi 'gyur ba'i nam mkha' ste stong pas chos nyid mi 'gyur ba mtshon pas so// tshon skud sna lnga'i 'ja' ris de la ye shes lnga rdzogs kyi nam mkha' zer sems kyi glud do// gnyis pa ni/ smyug ma de lta bu la/ rtse la bal tshon dang bya spu/ smad du dar sna'i 'phan phun bar du yungs kar gyi sgang bu de ni lus kyi glud/ byis pa'i glud du'ang bshad do// gsum pa ni/ shing shug pa la ral gri rtse gnyis pa'i dbyibs lta bu mtho gang la sbal mgo dmar po/ bar du mthing ka'i 'byed/ ngos kyi steng du nam mkha' la sprin lang long dang gza' skar/ de'i 'og tu ri dang yul khyim/ smad du mtsho rnams la srid pa spyi ris su bri ba zer/ de'i dbus su lha gang yin gyi gzugs rgyab tu mtshang tshig ste rang sngags bri ba ni gang zag sgos bri/

yul mkhar gyi 'og tu so so'i phyag mtshan bri ba ni/ so so'i spyod ris su bris pa zhes bya'o// de yul dang mkhar gyi glud/ bzhi pa ni/ mda' lha so so'i mdog dang mthun pa la/ mda' tshad dam khru gang*/ bskyed pa'i sa bon bri ba rang rtags dang sbyar ba de yang thugs dkyil ba rnams la hūm̐/ rdo rje pho nya mo rnams la bh+yo/ yab rnams la e/ sde brgyad rnams la a ma a ra phu tsa dza ra/ phyogs skyong sogs lhag ma tri/ bstan ma sogs ston pa'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i dus lag tu rdo rje gtad pa yin pas rdo rje re bri ba la dbang rtags dang sbyar ba zhes bya/ rang rang gi phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan ma nor ba bri/ stod du sgro bzhi dang stong mdzes pa'i tshon ris/ smad du nya mig dang bcas pa'i mde'us brgyan pa'o// 'di mda' rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pas sku'i bskang rdzas/ bskyed pa'i sa bon gsung gi phyag mtshan bkod pa thugs kyi/ mda'i bcas mde'u sogs yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi bskang rdzas/ skyes pa pho'i glud do// lnga pa ni/ 'phang lo mas nas 'khor bas mas nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyis kha dog sngo ljang dmar dkar ser bskor ba la 'jig rten snang tshul du bri ba zer/ 'phang lha dang mthun pa'i mdog tu btang ba dang*/ sa bon phyag mtshan bri ba la gang zag gnas lugs su bri ba zer/ dung 'phang 'chong long can/ gser 'phang g.yu long can/ lcags 'phang dung long can du byas pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du bri ba'o// tshad bud med kyi 'phang dang mnyam pa'am mtho tshad/ rtse la dar sna dang za 'og gis brgyan pa mo'i glud do// drug pa ni/ pho shing stag pa la pho gdong*/ mo shing glang ma la mo gdong*/ rang rang gi gdong yan lag bzhi/ 'og tu nya mig ris dar zab kyi gos gyon pa bya'o// pho gdong pho glud/ mo gdong mo glud/ bdun pa ni/ mchod sbyin gyi shing*/ brgyad pa shug pa 'dab ma rtse tshad phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyal mtshan srog chags kyi gzugs dang*/

gzhan logs rer khyu mchog dang nya dang stag dar zab kyi rgyal mtshan/ zur re rer 'phyar ba'i ru 'phan/ de yang dar ras sam shog bu la'o// gnyis pa dkor cha'i glud ni/ 'dra ba'i glud dang mthun pa'i glud/ 'dra glud la yon bdag dang 'dra glud/ pho mo byis pa rta phyugs yul mkhar ji lta ba yas su bya/ rin chen brdar ba'i lam sa la gru bzhi byas pa ser po sa cha'i glud/ mthun pa'i glud/ che dgu/ gser dngul mu tig zangs lcags khrab kyi byang bu mkhar ba bse dung*/ chung glud/ rta g.yag mdzo drel ba lang ra lug khyi phag rnams yon bdag dang mthun pa'i glud/ rgod/ gong mo/ bya nag rma bya/ ne tso/ pu shud/ skyung ka khyim bya/ ngang pa sogs 'dab chags 'phur dgu /seng ge stag gzig gung*/ spyang ki spre'u/ wa mo/ dred/ dom sogs gcan gzan che dgu /sha ba/ gla ba/ rna ba/ dgo ba/ gnyan/ gtsod/ rkyang*/ ri bong*/ rgya sogs ri dwags che dgu/ de rnams lha 'dre nor dang mthun pa'i glud yin/ bsdus na'ang de tsam dgos/ gzhan 'dab chags khyung nas phye leb kyi bar mkha' la 'phur tshad/ seng ge nas sre mong gi bar sder chags/ rta nas ra lug gi bar rmig chags/ khyu mchog nas sdig pa la sogs pa'i bar rwa chags te sa la spyod tshad/ chu srin nas sbal lcong gi bar chu la gnas tshad kyi gzugs gang mang*/ gsum pa spyan gzigs pho brgyud dgyes pa rngon cha/ mo brgyud dgyes pa rak+ta/ gnyis ka dgyes pa ba ling+ta 'bru sha sna snying sna khrag sna la byas pa la rdzas klungs rdzas 'bru sna rin po che/ sman sna dar zab stag ras gzig ras lug ra'i pags pa sogs lpags pa thams cad do/ de la rngon cha ni/ chang rngon/ gser rngon/ g.yu rngon/ mtsho rngon/ chang rngon la/ gnyan phud/ bar phud/ mtha' phud do// snal thags kyi gdugs tog nam mkha'/ thags ci shes pas brgyan/ gnyis pa bca' tshul la/ sgos mdos med pa dang yod pa'i lugs so// dang po gzhi ba byung gi rnam lnga/ dri bzang ngam/

bsad khrag gis sbags pa 'bru khal bcu gsum gyi dar phye la rin po che sna tshogs btab pa la/ dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa/ rten bskang dgra mdos tshad rim pa bzhin khru bcu gnyis brgyad bzhi par bya'o// dbus 'phar ma la lcog brgyad/ shar dkar/ lho mthing*/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba/ steng du rnam rgyal khang bzang*/ 'og gi phyir gser ri bdun/ rol mtsho bdun/ phyi'i rgya mtsho la gling bcu gnyis bkod/ lcags ri nag pos bskor ba'o// de la rtser bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ bang rim dang por thugs/ gnyis pa gsung*/ gsum par sku dkyil/ bzhi par phyogs skyong dang rgyal po bzhi/ mgon po rnams la nag po bcu gsum gyi rgyal mtshan sha khrag snying*/ dpal bshos re re/ nag po bcu gsum ni/ rta/ g.yag ra/ lug bya rog khyi/ skyes pa/ bud med/ drel/ dom/ dred phag bong bu'o// gsung dkyil ba rnams la/ tsa ta ka ne tso/ ri skegs/ khu byug nī la bi/ phug ron/ bya dkar tsa tra ka ngur pa/ ngang pa/ hor pa/ shing sta mo/ bya rog bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ ri dgas dgra/ gtsug phud can/ bya nag bhi ḍa ni/ 'ol ba/ khrung khrung*/ khu byug mig ra dza ki bha ga bha ti/ ti ti ra/ bzhad/ chu bya rog po/ chu skyar/ mig sngon/ tsa ko ra/ a nī la/ pha wang*/ sug ki ṭi ṭa ṭi bhi/ bhe run ḍi/ aṃ bha ri ka re 'dab chags/ khyi mo/ rgod ma/ glang mo/ ba/ lug mo/ ra mo/ ri dwags mo/ bong mo/ phag mo/ rnga mo/ 'brog khyi mo/ sed mo/ bse mo/ stag mo/ dom mo/ sbre mo/ 'bri mo/ ce spyang mo/ sram mo/ byi la mo/ kum bi ri/ 'gron bu mo/ karka ṭa/ nya mo/ chu srin mo/ sbal pa mo/ ru sbal mo/ dud mo/ go dhi/ byi ba mo/ sha dza ta ki spre'u mo/ ri bong mo/ gzugs mo byi thur/ i shu ki rtsangs pa rnams so// skyung ka sgrib/ lci lding*/ pu shud/ dur bya/ phug ron/ khyim bya/ spyi ber than bya/ dar thod can/ mchil ba/ 'ug pa/ se mo/ bya wang*/ pho rog ma mo'i spyi skongs so// sha khrag snying dpal bshos re re/

sku dkyil gyi sde brgyad la 'og tu 'chad pa bzhin gyi sha khrag snying bshos bu/ rgyal po bzhi la gtsang bshos/ gser rta g.yu mi/ g.yu rta gser mi/ mchong rta dung mi/ shel g.yag byi ru'i mdzo/ phyogs skyong bcu la/ gtsang bshos/ glang po che/ ra/ ma he/ mi/ chu srin/ sha ba/ rta/ khyu mchog ngang pa/ phag rnams kyi sha khrag snying rgyal mtshan/ phyogs bzhir bstan ma dang sman mo rnams la dar gyi sman le zlum po gnyis brtsegs pa'i steng ma pang du bu 'khur bas brtsegs ma gsum pa sna lnga/ mtshal gyis thig phran bal ti shug ti mda' 'phang ngar gyi bye'u gnam rgyang la mtshon gyis brgyan pa'o// rgya mtsho bdun la/ chur gnas/ ri bdun la/ gnam la 'phur dgu/ sa la gnas pa/ mda' 'phang dang*/ phyi ma la gnas rgyang bzhi lha grangs phyogs rer rgyal mtshan mtshams su ru dar bzhi dbus su tshon skud kyi gdugs phub bla re bres/ dar 'phyar/ rgyang thag bzhi bre/ 'dod yon/ rin po che/ zas sogs rgyan gyi rnam pa zar tshags su bris/ la rdzas klungs rdzas sman sna 'bru sna gos sna 'byor tshad bsham/ 'og tu mdos nas khal gnyis dgram/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams su mar me brgyad/ rngon cha dang phud bshos cha ci 'byor bsham mo// gnyis pa sgos mdos byed na/ ma mo la sku gsum mtshon pas/ ri rab bang rim gsum pa gru gsum steng du bum pa thod dgram/ lha dbang phyug chen po 'khor bcas la/ ri rab bang rim bzhi brtsegs khyu mchog ngang pa/ chu srin/ rta/ glang po che/ rma bya/ khyung*/ seng ge stag gzig rnams kyi rgyal mtshan/ bza' bca' gtsang ma'i lha bshos/ bdud la/ ri rab bang rim gnyis pa'i steng du/ bdud kyi mkhar nag po la dgu lung dgus bskor/ seng ge glang po/ rta/ bya/ khyi/ g.yag nag po/ 'brug ra/ phag dom/ bya rgod/ khyung*/ dar gyi rgyal mtshan/ srog chags de dag gi sha khrag snying*/ bdud bshos rnams/ gshin rje la/ ri rab gru gsum bang rim gsum gyi khar thod skam/

rta dmar/ ra dkar/ lug nag g.yag kham/ ma he/ 'ug pa/ srin bya/ rma bya/ dom/ ba dan dmar po/ khram shing gi bam/ sha khrag gshin rje'i bshos/ drang srong gza' la/ ri rab gru gsum bang rim gsum pa/ steng du bum pa/ mi/ bya/ rta/ g.yag ra/ lug rtol nag stag gzig phag nag rnams kyi rgyal mtshan/ sha khrag snying*/ bshos bu nag po'i liṅga can/ dung*/ bse/ khrab byang*/ stag ras/ gzig ras/ sha rul/ khrag rul/ nya rul la sogs pa dang*/ ra mchin la sogs pa yab kyi rdzas/ dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman ga bur yul gyi rdzas/ stag dom/ ba lang*/ nya'i snying gdong mo bzhi'i rdzas so// klu la/ mdos gza' 'dra ba/ sbrul mgo bdun pa/ lnga pa/ bzhi pa/ gsum pa/ gcig pa/ chu rta/ chu glang*/ chu lug chu rtsangs/ gtsang ma'i klu bshos/ btsan gyi brag steng mkhar stabs/ rta/ ra/ khyi/ glang rnams dmar po/ g.yag kham pa/ khra/ srin bya/ 'ug pa/ lug gi rgyal mtshan/ sha khrag snying*/ btsan bshos/ gnod sbyin la/ ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'i rtser nor bu/ nag po bcu gsum/ 'bri mo gsal le/ ne'u le/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ shing tog sna tshogs dang gtor ma/ gnod sbyin gyi bshos bu/ rgyal po la/ dbu rtse ris gsum/ gling g.yog skor khang phyi lcags ri dang bcas pa/ stag gzig spra spre/ seng ge glang po/ khyi dang*/ bya nag za 'og gi rgyal mtshan/ mchod rten nag po/ la rdzas/ dar zab/ gser/ dngul/ rams/ rgya skyegs/ btsod/ zhu mkhan/ lga g.yer/ ka ra bu ram/ bse phor dmar po/ dkar mo lag ya/ pha wang long bu/ srog chags snga ma dag gi sha khrag rgyal bshos dgu de thams cad la gdugs re rgyan glud/ dkor glud/ spyan gzigs/ rngon cha rnams dgu dgur gtor chen bzhin phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod/ de'i phyi zur gsum du 'brub khung*/ bsad/ sreg mnan pa'i liṅga bcug pa/ dre'u rngog gam g.yang gzhi'i gdan lpags bu dkar nag tshe rten lug dang rta/ srog rten mda' phur/ dbang rten nas mdun du bdar te cho ga bzhin du gyer ro// bcas 'tshar 'phral/

bsang chu swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdud rtsi bran/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas bsrung ba bya'o// mdos kyi bshad pa 'phrul gyi me long chen po pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /shu bhamastu sar+b+ba dza tāṃ/// /
